_comment: Deterministic Opportunity Score for Eagle Eye Innovations. Every metric is a COUNTABLE number fetched from an official API. The LLM never invents the number — it only interprets it. Weights must sum to 1.0.

target._verify: 08631843 is the assumed EEI Companies House number — CONFIRM the entity at developer.company-information.service.gov.uk before relying on it for company_health / company_filings.

keyword_query: drone OR RPAS OR UAV OR "unmanned aircraft" OR "aerial survey"
_competitor_note: Populate competitor_company_numbers with verified UK competitor company numbers (8-digit). Left empty by default so the metric scores neutrally rather than on bad data.

categories.metric: count of notices published in last 7 days matching keyword_query
count of last-7-day notices with CPV in defense/security range
count of new filings in last 30 days across competitor_company_numbers watchlist
EEI company status active=full; any adverse flag (liquidation/insolvency/overdue) reduces
sum of estimated values (GBP) of relevant last-7-day notices
